goal: Determine whether the organization should pursue a grant

context.description: The business information this decision depends on. seedFields names what must be present before any execution requirement runs; each requirement then declares what it reads and writes. Evaluation reads the same context execution wrote into, not a separate copy.

rules.description: Applicant must satisfy all mandatory eligibility requirements
Applicant must operate within the grant's specified geographic scope
All required application information must be present before assessment proceeds
Strong alignment cannot overcome a failed mandatory requirement

policies.description: Flag uncertainty rather than defaulting to a confident conclusion

executionRequirements.responsibility: Evaluate the applicant against the grant's mandatory eligibility requirements
Confirm the applicant operates within the grant's geographic scope
Confirm all required application information is present
Assess the organization's mission and programs for alignment with the funder's stated priorities

criteria: Eligibility follows the grant's mandatory requirements
Fit classification reflects the funder's stated priorities
An ineligible applicant is never recommended for pursuit
The classification is supported by evidence present in the context
Uncertainty is surfaced rather than resolved into false confidence
